verdict.rationale: Milvus clearly supports batching on the read side: search accepts a list of one or more query vectors and is labeled as supporting batch, and it can run several ANN searches simultaneously across vector fields. CRUD operations are documented only generically, with no explicit evidence of bulk insert, upsert or delete, or bulk import of many items at once. missing for 10: documented bulk insert/upsert/delete or bulk-import workflows, filter-based mass updates/deletes, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk operations at scale.
